Kyber is a decentralized liquidity protocol for token swaps on public blockchains. Kyber operates through smart contracts without intermediaries. Kyber is associated with the KNC token, which is used for staking and governance.

Balancer is an automated market maker protocol built on smart contracts. Balancer supports liquidity pools that hold multiple tokens with custom weights. Balancer is associated with the BAL governance token.

BadgerDAO is a decentralized autonomous organization focused on yield generation for Bitcoin holders. BadgerDAO operates vaults that deploy deposited assets into yield strategies. BadgerDAO is associated with the BADGER governance token.
